name: E — Sensor degradation
description: One aircraft approaches steadily from the north while the radar's performance falls away underneath it: nominal for the first hundred seconds, then a third of its detections with two and a half times the error, then silent from two hundred seconds onward. The other sensors are unaffected throughout.
purpose: To make sensor failure a visible, tested state rather than something the system quietly absorbs. The dangerous outcome is not losing the track — it is continuing to render a confident-looking picture built on data that has stopped arriving (FM-010).
expected_behaviour: must mark the radar degraded, and then offline, in system health and in the operator interface
must continue tracking the object on the remaining sensors
track uncertainty must visibly widen as radar support is lost, not stay where it was
must not suppress alerting because a sensor is unhealthy
must not present the degraded period as nominal, and must not claim radar support after the radar goes silent
if aggregate sensor coverage falls below the usable threshold, degraded mode must be entered and stated in the UI

objects.description: Medium aircraft approaching from due north at a steady 24 m/s.

sensor_availability.reason: Radar returns intermittent and noisy — antenna drive fault developing
